Planner: This morning, cabin readiness needs a look before the shift ends. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is checking carrier fit, comfort supplies, and the latest cabin notes for Aurelia Skyways.
Coordinator: I am reviewing today’s file so we can keep guidance clear for each traveler and keep the handoff simple for crews.
Planner: The pet desk queue is light, which gives us space to confirm documents and make sure each booking has the right support in place.
Coordinator: I have a reminder set to share practical instructions with the cabin team, including crate placement, water access, and calm handling.
Planner: Naomi Patel called earlier to confirm her service request, and the details are in order after the last review.
Coordinator: Leila Muller also sent a note, and her pet Gus is listed with the expected travel items and seating arrangement.
Planner: Good. I will keep the language steady and reassuring when we reply, so passengers know what to expect before departure.
Coordinator: That works. Clear guidance helps reduce last minute confusion and gives the crew a clean summary to follow.
Planner: I am also checking that the carrier labels are easy to read and that the contact details match the reservation file.
Coordinator: I will update the shared log with the review outcome and note that the cabin brief is ready for the shift handoff.
Planner: If anything changes, we can pass it along promptly and keep the service calm for the traveler and the pet.
Coordinator: Agreed, and the desk will stay available for any follow up that comes in before boarding begins.
